about.desc2: It rapidly restores the intestinal mucosal barrier and adsorbs harmful substances to relieve symptoms when newborn animals suffer from diarrhea due to viral, bacterial, or protozoan infections.
about.ingredientVal: High-purity ultra-fine nano montmorillonite + Bacillus subtilis
about.dosageVal:
✅ Recommended Dosage (1 pump = approx. 1ml = approx. 1g): Based on 5kg
Prevention & Routine (No diarrhea): 1-2 times daily, 1-2 drops
Intensive Care (Diarrhea present): 1-2 drops every 2 hours
